purpose: Prospective diagnostic comparison of a blend-product-conditioned, smooth quasi-1D nozzle ODE PINN with an otherwise identical data-only control, scored against exact isentropic solutions.
authorization_boundary: User-authorized additive implementation and diagnostic execution after this registration and reviewed code are committed and all registered post-chain, source, property, AC and lease gates pass. No active-chain change, production integration or empirical claim.

scope.claim: Accuracy and the incremental effect of governing residuals inside the two declared smooth, calorically-perfect nozzle regimes only.
excluded: Internal or exit normal shocks, transition between unchoked and choked branches, external jet expansion, viscous loss, separation, variable-cp expansion and reacting expansion.
Experimental nozzle validation, engine thrust/emission skill, operational blend rankings and certification claims.
Retired nozzle network reuse or alteration of the original Track 4 registration, oracle, results or registered chain.
scope.source_properties_interpretation: gamma and R are frozen coefficients copied from a specified simulator product-mixture source state. They are not claimed constant along a real heated-mixture expansion.
scope.conditioning: Only x, NPR, gamma and R are model features; fuel fractions and source draw/design IDs are provenance. Equal gamma/R inputs represent equal calorically-perfect gases even when blend identities differ.

dependencies.training_rows_contract: teacher_rows.csv and teacher_species.npz contain TRAIN4096 only: split=train, prefix_index=0..4095, design_id=train_000000..train_004095 in joint-Sobol index order; 4096 total rows, exactly 64 per draw, never 4096x64. Every row remains a separately identified product test case.
dependencies.named_rows_contract: Exactly the registered 17 central fuels x4 modes=68 input/property rows. Read only canonical input IDs, fractions, mode/thrust fraction, status/reason, gamma4/R4/cp4 and provenance hashes; never ff/T4 or sealed named species/target bytes.
dependencies.producer: Selected frozen Phase 7 v6 parameters, fixed 64 registered engine draws, full-equilibrium C++ V6Engine, single-zone combustor_air_fraction=1; capture full CppEngine.run_at_thrust output rather than the reduced solve_task row.
dependencies.property_manifest_binding: Per-row property_manifest_sha256 binds the frozen pre-generation property-input/provenance manifest; the separate final property_manifest.json binds generated TRAIN/named property/species output hashes. Verify both without a self-hash cycle, against the selected shared Context binary and original proof.

source_field_mapping.Y: combustor.Y_out in frozen CRECK species order -> teacher_species.npz

dependencies.property_validity: Require finite gamma/R/cp, gamma>1, R>0, cp>R, abs((cp/(cp-R))/gamma-1)<=1e-10, aligned TRAIN species rows/order, finite nonnegative TRAIN Y with abs(sum(Y)-1)<=1e-10. Validate four-component mass-simplex fractions for TRAIN and 16 ordinary named fuels. JetA_dooley2010 is an included alternate-fuel context with in_product_API=false and null four-component fractions; verify its separately frozen protected fuel_parts provenance, never relabel or drop it. Named species are sealed and not read; producer identity comes from the allowed property manifest. Malformed or mismatched evidence blocks before labels.
dependencies.species_role: TRAIN4096 product-mixture provenance only; no species or source ff/T4 prediction target is learned by this nozzle study. Use exact C++ teacher properties, never properties predicted by the P8-S student. Do not open validation/test/ranking or named sealed target/species artifacts.
dependencies.mixture_coverage: ALL 4096 fixed TRAIN source-row IDs plus ALL 68 named central fuel/mode IDs are included independently, even when coefficients repeat. Freeze their canonical input identities before reading coefficient values; no coefficient-, error- or value-based downselection and no redundant full-draw crossproduct.
dependencies.missing_or_unconverged_rows: Retain and count every registered missing/unconverged source row. Any such row blocks a full registered-blend-coverage claim; do not impute, clip or silently drop it.
dependencies.pre_label_manifest: Before any nozzle oracle labels or residual training, write and review a new write-once manifest freezing source registration/teacher/species hashes, source and binary identity, all case IDs/split inputs, oracle/implementation hashes, this registration hash and declared output paths.
dependencies.old_rung_evidence: Require hash-verified PASS evidence from the original Track 4 attempt; original shock oracle and its exclusion remain visible in the new report. Do not rerun or overwrite the original attempt.
launch_gates: Main benchmark/calibration/diagnostic/full-test chain has terminal validated records and released ownership.
AC power, fail-closed process/lease checks, no competing heavy job, one CPU thread and nice>=15.
Committed/reviewed implementation and manifest; all frozen inputs/sources/binary hashes readable and unchanged at launch and finalization.
Registered source properties are available and fall inside the fixed envelope; all smooth-regime analytic admissibility checks pass.

shared_operational_gate.original_proof: outputs/phase8/screening_operations/main_dependency.json; exported with original strict validate_terminal_context(require_idle=True) before additive source/test integration, preserving raw original queue/command/owner-release records and hashes.
shared_operational_gate.source_extension: Only exact NEW files and hashes in the committed operational source-extension manifest may extend the frozen original scientific roots. Every original tracked blob/mode/working byte, registration/input and built module stays unchanged; no wildcard or reinterpretation of old source identity.
shared_operational_gate.g0_receipt: outputs/phase8/screening_operations/g0_evidence.json, reviewed/committed write-once original-rule PASS evidence with raw verdict/table hashes and selected core identity
shared_operational_gate.completion: Shared helper exclusively writes terminal evidence and downgrades completion on drift/incomplete evidence. Reserve with O_EXCL after proven original release, recheck before each stage and at exit; no names-based waiter, log-text completion or dead-PID inference. Any lease blocks idle authorization.
shared_operational_gate.idle_order: No active chain is changed or resumed. Validate original proof and registered extension, require idle/AC, acquire own shared lease, then permit lazy scientific imports and stage execution.

gas_and_geometry.envelope_basis: Prospective deliberately broad calorically-perfect diagnostic box, chosen before inspecting blend-product values. It is not a measured blend-property interval. A source-property miss yields BLOCKED_SCOPE; widening requires a new prospective registration before labels.
gas_and_geometry.scaling: xi=x/L_ref; rho_hat=rho/rho_ref; u_hat=u/u_ref; T_hat=T/T0; p_hat=p/p0. Fixed scales for every blend, seed, arm and split; derivatives use physical chain factors.

smooth_subcritical.boundary: p_exit=p_back; wholly subsonic branch with A_star<A_throat.
smooth_subcritical.oracle: M_exit=sqrt(2/(gamma-1)*(NPR^((gamma-1)/gamma)-1)); because inlet and exit areas are equal, M_in=M_exit. Call existing QuasiOneD.smooth_subsonic(M_in).

smooth_choked.boundary: M_throat=1; subsonic convergent and supersonic divergent branches. p_exit follows the area-Mach relation and is not set equal to p_back.
smooth_choked.oracle: Call existing QuasiOneD.choked_isentropic(); profile is independent of NPR inside this underexpanded regime. External expansion is outside scope.

regimes.admissibility: For gamma in the entire [1.2,1.4] interval, solve Ae/At=1.5 for M_e^-<1 and M_e^+>1 using the existing area oracle. Require 1.08 < (1+(gamma-1)*(M_e^-)^2/2)^(gamma/(gamma-1)) and 8 >= (1+(gamma-1)*(M_e^+)^2/2)^(gamma/(gamma-1)). Validate endpoint/extremum reasoning and a prospective 1001-point gamma check before label generation; numerical failure blocks, never adjusts NPR.
regimes.gap: All NPR outside the two closed intervals, including the first-choking transition, internal-shock interval, shock-at-exit cases and overexpanded supersonic exits, are excluded and explicitly refused. No interpolation claim through the gap.

oracle.independent_reference_gate: Existing exact oracle mass/total-enthalpy/total-pressure/area-roundtrip relative checks <=1e-10; declared branch and throat checks must pass before it supplies labels. Before training, gate only the old independent oracle cases and training conditions; compute test-profile invariants only within the sealed final scoring pass, after all checkpoints are frozen.
oracle.implementation_boundary: Add a separate wrapper for NPR-to-subcritical-inlet-Mach selection and dimensional configuration; preserve old oracle and registration bytes. No autograd through root solves or shocks.
oracle.reference_note: Exact solution of the declared calorically-perfect equations only; C++ supplies conditioning properties, not nozzle validation targets.

splits.unit: Whole condition tuple (regime,NPR,gamma,R); all x locations of a condition remain in one split. Exact float identity, disjoint parameter tuples and no duplicate test profiles; reject overlap rather than resample after scores.

training.sampler: scrambled 3D Sobol, draw_base2(m=6), seed=20261004; affine gamma/R mapping and separate affine NPR mapping within each regime

validation.sampler: scrambled 3D Sobol, draw_base2(m=5), seed=20261005; same maps
validation.role: Final-checkpoint reporting only; no early stopping, model/loss selection or extra training.

synthetic_test.sampler: scrambled 3D Sobol, draw_base2(m=6), seed=20261006; same maps
synthetic_test.stress_conditions: All gamma/R box corners crossed with each regime's NPR endpoints and midpoint, registered by input identity before labels.

product_test.condition_properties: All TRAIN4096 and named68 fixed source-row IDs, keeping duplicate coefficients and source identities; coefficients stay frozen while p0/T0 use study constants. Never P8-S validation/test/ranking or sealed named targets.

splits.collocation: Training conditions only, inclusive linspace(-1,1,65) per condition; identical frozen collocation inputs for both arms. Never use validation, synthetic-test or product-test conditions as physics collocation.
splits.test_sealing: Case-input identities are frozen before training; exact test fields remain unopened/uncomputed for training, selection or stopping. Freeze all six final checkpoints and optimizer records, then perform one synchronous final test pass for every arm/seed. No best-seed choice, retries or replacement checkpoint after any test score.

architecture.output_transform: independent softplus(z)+1e-12 for all four outputs; no hardwired EOS, exact-solution skip, Mach branch or analytic correction

models.initialization: PyTorch nn.Linear default bias=True, CPU float64 at construction, torch.manual_seed(seed). Copy identical initial state to both arms of each seed pair.
models.data_loss: Mean squared error averaged equally over four scaled primitive outputs and every registered training interior label.
models.boundary_loss: Same exact primitive-label MSE at x=-1,0,1 for every training condition in both arms. These are supervised boundary/throat labels; data_only has these labels but no differential or EOS residual penalty.
models.physics_loss: Equal mean of the four registered squared dimensionless residuals at the frozen training collocation points; no adaptive/gradient balancing or weight search.

optimizer.final_state: Exactly registered Adam steps followed by the registered LBFGS termination/caps. Retain final state; no score-selected checkpoint or budget extension.

models.budget_comparison: Identical architecture, labels, initialization, seeds, optimizer step/evaluation caps and checkpoint rule; report wall time and actual evaluations because residual differentiation costs more work than data-only training. No speed claim from unmatched arithmetic budgets.

governing_residuals.derivative: d/dxi, at fixed NPR,gamma,R; a=1+0.5*xi^2, r=R/R_ref, c=gamma*r/(gamma-1)
governing_residuals.normalizers: mass: rho_ref*u_ref*A_throat/L_ref; momentum: p0/L_ref; energy: R_ref*T0/L_ref; EOS: p0. Primitive residuals remain finite at the sonic throat; do not divide by M^2-1.
governing_residuals.not_ma_replication: This is the declared inviscid quasi-1D conservation system, not Ma's two-dimensional viscous/RANS equations or their unresolved thermal coefficient.

acceptance.per_seed_and_test_panel: Report synthetic-test and product-test metrics separately, both NPR regimes separately, all fields/cases and all six arm/seed outcomes. No pooled statistic may hide a failed field, case, regime or seed.
acceptance.profile_aggregation: For each condition and each field separately, max and RMS are over its 161 x locations; all condition/field values must meet the corresponding bar. Residual max/RMS likewise apply per condition and residual component. Invariant bars apply to the worst point of each condition.
acceptance.relative_denominator: Positive exact value at each scored point; no percentage floor or excluding throat/endpoints. Non-finite or non-positive prediction is FAIL.
acceptance.branch_checks: Subcritical: M<1 throughout. Choked: M<1 for xi<=-0.05, M>1 for xi>=0.05; throat bar above. No wrong-branch case is accepted.
acceptance.choked_invariance_definition: For each separately identified TRAIN/named product row, compare every primitive prediction across NPR 8,10,12 at matching x; max spread divided by the positive exact field <=bar. Do not demand p_exit=p_back.
acceptance.physics_on_accuracy_pass: All three physics_on seeds must pass every accuracy, positivity, branch, residual and invariance bar on both final test panels.

physics_benefit.metric: Per-seed equal-weight RMS over four primitive pointwise relative errors, formed separately for each test panel and regime.
physics_benefit.required: On every panel/regime, median of three paired physics_on/data_only RMSE ratios <=0.8 and at least two paired ratios <1.0. Zero data-only RMSE cannot establish improvement. All pairs must be finite and complete; no failed control is replaced.
physics_benefit.failure_interpretation: Accuracy PASS without this comparison is no demonstrated residual benefit. Neither result implies experimental validity or permission to restore a retired model.

acceptance.failure_policy: Record FAIL/ERROR/BLOCKED with complete available logs and hashes; do not adjust envelope, sample counts, losses, architecture, seeds, budgets or thresholds using test results. A new attempt requires a prospective registration retaining all earlier evidence.

outputs.checkpoint_policy: New arm/seed checkpoints only under this output root, with registration/input/source identity; never overwrite models/*.pt or earlier attempts.
outputs.report_format: Machine-readable quantitative JSON/CSV/NPZ with numeric metrics, categorical gate/status codes, IDs and hashes only; no report.md or narrative results prose.
technical_README_required_limits: Schema, units, commands and frozen-source-state/calorically-perfect conventions; no results prose.
Prospective property box and explicit finite/coverage/out-of-envelope status fields.
Excluded shock/transition/external-expansion regimes and original rung-3 evidence fields.
Independent exact reference versus learned solution; data-only contains identical supervised boundary labels.
All seeds/panels and separate accuracy/incremental-physics decision definitions; no empirical or production claims.
outputs.start_end_identity: Freeze at start and recheck at exit; any source/input/binary/registration drift, incomplete evidence or missing required output makes ERROR and a nonzero exit. Interrupted attempts are retained and never mistaken for completion.

implementation_clarification_20261004.duplicate_profile_scope: The splits.unit duplicate-profile restriction applies to synthetic test conditions and cross-split training/validation/test identity collisions. ALL4164 product source rows remain separately identified even when coefficients and exact profiles repeat, as required by dependencies.mixture_coverage and splits.product_test; no product deduplication.
implementation_clarification_20261004.source_order: Canonical named source order follows the committed P8-S producer: lexicographic order of the exact 17 named fuel names, then original TAKE-OFF/APPROACH/IDLE/CLIMB85 order. The named_fuels array identifies the required set. No selection or relabeling.
implementation_clarification_20261004.property_paths: P8-S property_inputs_manifest.json -> generation_terminal.json -> property_manifest.json. Binary/dependency/generation-output/log paths are MAIN-relative; final prior-manifest pointers use the exact basenames. Schema version is integer1. Only allowed TRAIN/property/input/provenance files are opened or hashed; sealed artifacts stay opaque.
implementation_clarification_20261004.pre_label_identity: The reviewed registration and implementation define the automatic manifest review: write the complete new input/case/source identity once and revalidate its hashes and all gates before generating any training exact fields. Test exact fields remain uncomputed until all six checkpoint hashes and the single score reservation are fixed.
implementation_clarification_20261004.unchanged_scientific_contract: No change to models, seeds, sample counts, numerical budgets, equations, scope, thresholds, old registered evidence or the requirement to retain every source-row identity.
